verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS incorporation service like Stripe Atlas, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting Atlas data (legal documents, cap table, filings) in open formats or a self-service way to leave. Community mentions of manually migrating Stripe accounts and subscriptions describe user workarounds, not an Atlas export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
